title: Marie‑Louise Müller — Berlin Fashion Week 2026
description: Photographed backstage for Marie‑Louise Müller during Berlin Fashion Week 2026, this series follows the collection through final fittings, quiet portraits, and the charged minutes before the models step out. The images move between sculptural floral surfaces, crocheted forms, vivid fringe, and watering-can props while keeping the collaborative choreography of the backstage team in view.
